criteria.intent: Correct and explainable repository, content, website and control routing
criteria.automated_scope: Retained T01 selection regressions verify exact review-template ownership and existing mixed/unknown/control source allocation. T02 adds a reviewed decision matrix and future observation interface; these mechanical checks do not establish their semantic completeness or execute the future classifier.

criteria.intent: A genuine protected repository-only merge without website deployment work
criteria.automated_scope: Neither T01 nor contract-only T02 establishes the future repository-only admission outcome. T02 retains the current required staging route and relevant repository checks.

criteria.intent: Integrate the existing content lane with accepted platform and complete intervening-history evidence
criteria.automated_scope: T01/T02 provide no actual content release, accepted-engine compatibility or recovery evidence. T02 documents dependencies and complete-history obligations; issue5 and PR79 retain implementation and release ownership.

criteria.intent: Preserve applicable website and control coverage, budgets, profiles and source architecture
criteria.automated_scope: Existing selection regressions and the bounded style guard retain their mechanical preservation scope. T02 changes documentation and necessary acceptance/RI companions only; actual CI, unchanged profile/budget/control behavior and semantic CS01/CS04/CS05/CS09/CS10 review remain separate.

criteria.intent: Admission cannot exempt itself or accept an impersonated or invalid result
criteria.automated_scope: T02 records the live ruleset and official platform capability disposition, without changing an admission producer, workflow or protection. No automated check here proves same-name wrong-producer rejection at the protected merge boundary; AC05 remains unresolved.

criteria.intent: Preserve accepted-site provenance and concurrency after repository-only merges
criteria.automated_scope: T02 defines distinct repository/accepted-site identities and future complete intervening-history obligations. It implements no new publication baseline, compatibility, lease or recovery behavior.

criteria.intent: Four actual independent roles and actionable test handoff for each coherent candidate
criteria.automated_scope: No deterministic check can establish separate nonauthoring execution, semantic requirement quality, independent test oracles or actual exploratory observations.

criteria.intent: Source-bound delivery, complete lane outcomes, documentation and measured result
criteria.automated_scope: Current catalog/RI freshness and CI coupling checks establish their mechanical subsets only. T02 contract usefulness, actual CI/staging/merge/postmerge and all future real lane outcomes and timing evidence remain external obligations.

ROUTING.description: Complete AC01's maintained lane/control table, actual additions/deletions/renames/type-change and mixed/unknown/incomplete-ref behavior, plus exact source/base/policy reports. T01 supplies the exact review-template correction; T02 supplies semantic contract review only. Independently review the table, field-level interface and eleven walkthroughs; executable classifier and whole-criterion evidence remain pending.

REPOSITORY-LANE.description: Observe a real protected repository-only merge after applicable source/RI/acceptance and independent-role checks, without hosted preview, website staging, alias or publisher actions. Demonstrate a changed RI executable failure blocks admission. Not delivered by T01 or T02.

CONTENT-LANE.description: Reconcile issue5/PR79's actual independent content release and recovery. Authenticate accepted engine/schema and complete accepted-site S through repository-only M to content C history; invalid content/media/references, incompatible or unknown intervening inputs must fail or require fresh website validation. T02 defines the contract, not the executed outcome.

COVERAGE.description: Inspect actual owners, dependency closure and required CI to confirm baseline, permanent source, repository, website/control, staging and production obligations, budgets, failure propagation and provenance. Preserve optional diagnostics and applicable unautomated style rules. T02 documents existing versus proposed routes without changing behavior; whole future lane-level preservation remains pending.

TRUST.description: Revalidate and source the actual ruleset/producer capability. T02 may document unresolved enforcement, but W3 activation requires actual trusted evaluator and producer identity at the protection boundary: candidate policy/wrapper changes cannot exempt or impersonate admission; reject same-name foreign producers, wrong source/run/attempt and missing/failed/skipped/cancelled/stale required evidence, with explicit inapplicability and no Pending deadlock. Revised-design approval cannot waive AC05 proof.

PROVENANCE.description: Verify repository/controller and accepted site/platform/content/artifact identities independently after repository-only merge. Prove complete intervening compatibility or use fresh staging, without relabeling old artifacts. Exercise fresh-base decisions, source/predecessor leases and timing/recovery cases preserving newer accepted content. T02 specifies these requirements without executing the future scenario.

REQUIREMENTS.description: Actual separate nonauthoring Requirements & Acceptance Reviewer checks original intent, requirement quality, AC/check/gate traceability before dependent implementation, after material changes and on the completed candidate. Retain exact-source conclusions and unresolved decisions; task-definition review alone does not accept implementation.

REVIEW.description: Actual separate nonimplementing Code Reviewer inspects the complete candidate, tests, policy and RI integration, including applicable CS01/CS04/CS05/CS08/CS09/CS10. Record independent findings, scope and source; actually recheck affected corrections.

WHITEBOX.description: Actual distinct White-box QA independently inspects changed branches, boundaries, invariants and tests; records risk-to-oracle mapping, meaningful fault detection and actual source-bound results or execution gaps. It cannot accept tests or implementation it authored.

EXPLORATORY.description: Actual distinct Exploratory/Interaction QA executes an intent-derived charter on the changed surface. For T02, independently walk the maintained contract and operator actions against actual source/CLI/RI evidence; a prose walkthrough is not execution of the future classifier. Record environment, actions, expected/observed outcomes and regression/manual dispositions. Unavailable access is not non-applicability.

DELIVERY.description: Fetch current owning issue/PR, exact source CI including Basic and required selection, four actual independent-role results and all applicable external gates. Reconcile actual task/issue checkboxes and the one canonical documentation/RI contract. T01/T02 supply bounded increments; real lane outcomes and queue/setup/execution comparisons remain pending without fabricated speed claims.

MERGED.description: Use the maintainer-approved step scope to complete current staging/admission, protected-main merge and postmerge verification. Record tested source separately from merged commit/tree, then report and propose the next step for separate approval. All whole ACs remain open after T02; no production activation is requested.
